estimatedEffort: Multiple story cycles; implement in six independently reviewable increments. This is a sequencing estimate, not a delivery-date commitment.

dependencies.name: Fastify / @fastify/static
dependencies.purpose: Local API server and vanilla static panel.

dependencies.name: @twurple/auth / @twurple/api / @twurple/eventsub-ws
dependencies.purpose: Twitch OAuth/token lifecycle, Helix, and EventSub WebSocket.

dependencies.name: Prisma CLI / @prisma/client / @prisma/adapter-pg
dependencies.purpose: JavaScript client generation and PostgreSQL persistence/migrations.

dependencies.name: pg
dependencies.purpose: PostgreSQL driver for the Prisma adapter.

dependencies.name: PostgreSQL
dependencies.purpose: Local durable relational storage and concurrency constraints.

dependencies.name: Vitest
dependencies.purpose: JavaScript ESM unit and integration tests.

tddContract: Every behavioral subtask begins with a test-writing Red subtask that is run and records the expected missing-behavior failure. Implement only enough behavior for Green. Refactor in a separate step while rerunning affected tests. Database guarantees require isolated PostgreSQL and actual Prisma migrations. Keep exact commands/results in docs/stories.md and docs/pt-BR/stories.md; never mark a story done without observed evidence.

phases.name: Runtime identity, local bootstrap, and persistence foundation
phases.description: Create the version policy and the Docker/PostgreSQL foundation under apps/*; root Docker/Compose files remain product entrypoints.

subtasks.description: Write version-policy tests first for format, source consistency, marker without Git, seven hexadecimal SHA characters, stage allowlist, valid/missing/malformed Git discovery, materialization, and preservation during ordinary validation.
subtasks.notes: Red evidence must identify absent or incorrect version behavior; syntax/dependency failures do not count.

subtasks.description: Implement JavaScript ESM version parsing/validation/materialization and CLI after 1.1 is observed Red; add behavior only for covered cases.
subtasks.notes: Start at base 0.1.0, alpha, marker 0000000. Build artifact materialization uses exact source commit SHA prefix and never writes back into the versioned checkout.

subtasks.description: Write an isolated Compose contract test before creating runtime services; cover first-run topology, health/completion dependency order, no database host port, loopback app bind, named persistence, non-root bot, and no volume deletion in normal scripts.
Implement Dockerfile, Compose services, bootstrap secret-volume helper, and start scripts to pass 1.3; persist a generated password once and mount it read-only to db/migrate/bot consumers.
subtasks.notes: Add .dockerignore, .gitignore and start-script work in later subtasks limited to three files each. Prove bootstrap permissions and idempotency on supported Docker hosts before claiming parity.

subtasks.description: Write PostgreSQL migration contract tests before the data model, using an isolated test database; cover foreign/source integrity, global queue-key uniqueness, redemption uniqueness, and active-entry partial uniqueness.
Implement Prisma schema, JavaScript Prisma config, and versioned SQL migrations for the minimum persistence model and required unique/check constraints after 1.5 is observed Red.
subtasks.notes: Pin Prisma CLI/client/adapter to 6.19.3; use prisma-client-js; migrations run through Compose migrate before bot.

subtasks.description: Add version/runtime and first-run operator documentation/changelog records in English and pt-BR after the underlying behavior is verified.

verification.instructions: Cross-check commands/paths/identity between English and Portuguese documents; preserve genuine prior TDD evidence.

phases.name: Queue domain, UID, parser, and transactional order
phases.description: Pure behavior first; then PostgreSQL concurrency contracts using real migrations.

subtasks.description: Write transition decision-table tests for allowed/forbidden states, manual versus redemption sources, policy snapshots, external terminal events, and no unintended financial actions.
Implement pure transition validation and one domain transition service; keep state changes, audit/policy/outbox calls behind that service.
Write UID tests for nine ASCII digits, trim at edges, invalid lengths/additional text/Unicode, optional manual UID, and hidden-mode argument discard with zero logging/persistence effects.
Implement UID validation and mode policy after the cases in 2.3 fail for missing behavior.

Write pure parser and authorization tests for aliases/reserved names, whitespace/case/accents, argument count, viewer self-identity, trusted badges/current channel, VIP default off, and duplicate message IDs.
Implement the pure command parser and authorization predicate after the tests in 2.5 demonstrate missing behavior.
Write real-PostgreSQL race tests for same-viewer redemptions, call/remove/move contention, continuous waiting positions, and preservation of manually moved order across recovery.
Implement short transaction queue locking, active-user conflict mapping to durable duplicate cancellation, stable order shifts, and transactional move/next behavior after 2.7 Red.

phases.name: Durable outbox and remote financial recovery
phases.description: Persist local intention before Twitch effects; prove persistence with PostgreSQL and fake remote adapters.

subtasks.description: Write outbox tests for stable idempotency, commit-before-API ordering, crash-before-call recovery, expired lease recovery, retry/backoff, 429, 401, lost response, and opposite/unknown remote state.
Implement outbox state transitions, lease worker, bounded retry scheduling, sanitized errors, and remote confirmation against fake Twitch port after 3.1 Red.
Write real PostgreSQL integration tests for atomic terminal transition plus audit/outbox insertion, unique financial intent, lease claim, and restart recovery of rejected redemptions without entries.
Implement Prisma-backed outbox/audit repositories and recovery queries after 3.3 shows the missing persistence guarantees.
Write deletion-saga tests asserting no reward DELETE until every unfulfilled page is enumerated and all cancellations are remotely confirmed; test failure/unknown resume.
Implement resumable reward deletion phases and explicit remote verification after tests show unsafe or absent behavior.

phases.name: Twitch OAuth, reward adapters, EventSub, and reconciliation
phases.description: Use only the official source-verified scopes, endpoints, fields, and pinned Twurple APIs.

subtasks.description: Write fake-server contract tests for Client Credentials validation, Authorization Code exchange, state/session/expiry, broadcaster/client/scope checks, secret replacement, and secret non-disclosure.
Implement credential/OAuth workflows and secure token persistence using documented current Twurple methods after 4.1 Red.
Write Twitch adapter tests for reward title/prompt/limits, app ownership, skip-queue normalization, paginated redemption statuses, and Helix response/error mappings.
Implement normalized Twurple Helix reward and redemption adapters and verified app-owned reward association after tests in 4.3 fail for absent behavior.
Write EventSub/reconciliation tests for duplicate add/update, update-before-add terminal state, disconnect, paginated overlap, partial failure, missing-active lookup by ID, and no order regression.
Implement WebSocket subscription orchestration, event deduplication, and reconciliation sequencing after 4.5 Red; resume workers/timers only after applicable reconciliation.

phases.name: Chat commands, calls, timers, cleanup, and current account
phases.description: Connect Twitch messages to the domain service and preserve point/timeout policy on all exits.

subtasks.description: Write chat service tests for viewer self-identity, management authorization, message dedupe, five-second viewer cooldown, shared-chat channel filtering, compact Portuguese responses, and send result false/drop behavior.
Implement chat intake/execution through pure parser and domain service; use HelixChatApi and persist/send effects separately after 5.1 Red.

Write call/timer tests for 1-10 selection, previous waiting position in templates, notification outbox, deadline only after confirmed send, retry without silent extension, restart grace, and start-service racing no-show.
Implement recoverable call notification and timeout workers; render privacy-sensitive values at send time and have timer transitions revalidate entry state.
Write account/clear tests for individual versus group call, two queues, manual override, owner-only reset, same actor/channel/queue/active-set confirmation and expiry at 15 seconds.
Implement transactional account ownership and clear confirmation after tests fail; ensure terminal transitions use one shared domain service and include every active reward entry.

phases.name: Local panel, API safety, docs, and system acceptance
phases.description: Build the operator surface only after its underlying services and safety contracts have tests.

subtasks.description: Write Fastify route tests for session, CSRF, exact Host/Origin, OAuth callback exception, request schemas, idempotency/version conflict, product/API/state version distinction, and secret/UID projection safety.
Implement local session/CSRF/Host guards and explicit API projections after tests in 6.1 reproduce absent protections.
Write static UI smoke/accessibility tests for setup, connectivity, queue lifecycle, entries, financial states, reconciliation, visible errors, and textContent-only untrusted content.
Implement the vanilla local operator panel against documented API projections with no innerHTML of user-controlled values and no UI-only security decisions.
Write a Compose acceptance test for first start, login-not-required setup state, DB health/migration order, non-root bot health, restart persistence, and retained financial operation.

Finish bilingual integration/versioning/install/operation docs and user/internal changelogs, recording only observed TDD commands/results; then run all mandated project and PostgreSQL/Compose/version gates.

verification.instructions: Verify every affected document has its bilingual counterpart and reciprocal link; run all commands listed in README and record exact output in stories.

storySequence.scope: version, bilingual documentation, Compose/bootstrap, Prisma/PostgreSQL schema and migrations
queue domain, UID, parser, authorization, PostgreSQL ordering and concurrency
financial outbox, retries, confirmation, conflict, and crash recovery
Twitch OAuth, app-owned rewards, EventSub, adapters, and reconciliation
chat commands, call notifications, service/timeouts, clean confirmation, and account ownership
local panel/API, security, lifecycle acceptance, and operational documentation

gateNotes: Each story is refined/validated through AIOX Story Development Cycle before implementation.
TDD order is part of the task graph: test subtasks precede implementation subtasks and must demonstrate behavioral Red before implementation begins.
A behavior is not complete without Green, Refactor, and rerunning affected tests; no skip/ignore to conceal failures.
PostgreSQL guarantees require a real isolated database and migrations; mocks are only for external Twitch boundaries.
Official Twitch/Twurple/Prisma/PostgreSQL/Docker sources were recorded before integration planning; verify exact SDK APIs again against installed pinned package at implementation time.
Twitch real-credential verification remains pending until streamer authorizes and supplies their own app credentials.
Release/tag and alpha-stage promotion are not part of this foundation; @devops exclusively owns release/tag work.
